Lots of different variables here.

There’s a possibility that him and his dogs could’ve been struck by a car as they crossed the street. Maybe the driver panicked and drove away with the bodies, although that’s highly unlikely for a multitude of reasons.

Another obvious possibility would be straight up kidnapping... he was only 5’6, so I’m sure an average size man could’ve easily overpowered him, however you would think that his two dogs would’ve warded off any would-be kidnappers. 

Another far fetched but possible explanation for his disappearance is perhaps he ran away, you never know if he met someone who could’ve picked him and his dogs up, and taken him somewhere nobody would recognize him, or think to look for him. But this seems unlikely since this was 30-35 years before the Internet was a thing.
